description: This file defines the API for Device IP Diagnostics UploadDiagnostics in the TR-069 device management framework. It includes function prototypes for setting diagnostic parameters such as DiagnosticsState, Interface, UploadURL, DSCP, EthernetPriority, and TestFileLength, used to initiate and configure upload diagnostics tests on a device.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UploadDiagnostics_DiagnosticsState
methods.description: Sets the DiagnosticsState parameter to control the diagnostic test execution. Valid values include 'None', 'Requested', 'Completed', and various error states. Initiates or monitors the upload diagnostics test based on the value.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UploadDiagnostics_Interface
methods.description: Configures the network interface over which the diagnostics test will be performed.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UploadDiagnostics_UploadURL
methods.description: Sets the URL endpoint (HTTP or FTP) where the upload diagnostics data will be sent.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UploadDiagnostics_DSCP
methods.description: Configures the Differentiated Services Code Point for marking packets.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UploadDiagnostics_EthernetPriority
methods.description: Sets the Ethernet priority code for packet marking during tests.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UploadDiagnostics_TestFileLength
methods.description: Specifies the size in bytes of the test file to be uploaded.
